newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - June BTPs to test support 128.60.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - June BTPs to test support 128.60.

text.p: June BTP futures on LIFFE were forecast to slide on Tuesday and test support at 128.60 in tandem with weakening French bonds after a surprise win for the French left on Sunday's first round of elections, technical analysts said.

Norman Beauchamp, head of derivatives at Cooperative Bank in London, said a critical level to trigger the slump would likely be 129.05 which, if broken, could open the way for 128.60, a 60 percent retracement from the recent highs, followed by 127.94.
"Italy I think you have got to be very wary of. It could come down very sharply," Beauchamp said.
By 0755 GMT, June BTPs were 80 basis points lower at 129.10.
